claims: Maintain continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) with documented dialysis catheter and Prismasate/citrate anticoagulation.
Continue invasive mechanical ventilation via CPAP/PSV with PEEP 10 cmH2O and titrate inspired oxygen to maintain SpO2 ≥ 92%.
Continue norepinephrine infusion and titrate to maintain MAP ≥ 65 mmHg.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess acid-base status and oxygenation.
Monitor platelet count and coagulation profile given severe thrombocytopenia (platelets 12–29 K/uL).
Monitor serum potassium and magnesium and replete as needed given hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin infusion to maintain glycemic control.
Monitor lactate clearance to assess adequacy of resuscitation.
Perform daily sedation interruption and delirium assessment (CAM-ICU) given positive screen.
Maintain VTE prophylaxis and consider transfusion thresholds in the setting of severe thrombocytopenia.
